steps.name: a fresh instance serves the app and reports that it has no owner
the first account gets its starter notes, and a new note is stored
a change on one device notifies the other through SyncHub
two-factor setup and sign-in go through CredentialVault
a socket stays connected while SyncHub hibernates
CredentialVault still opens the stored secret after it sleeps
the account, notes, and vault key survive a restart

changes.what: Replaces the [exports.SyncHub] and [exports.CredentialVault] tables in wrangler.toml with one migration that creates both SQLite classes.
changes.why: Unmodified, orange dev exits with: Unsupported Wrangler configuration: exports. The build copies that field into dist/inkstone/wrangler.json, the config that npm run deploy uses. The patch shows what lies behind that Orange bug.
